HCR1, 'Concurrent Resolution to Work Together to Address the Climate, Public Lands, and Carbon Sequestration,' which lays out a win-win strategy for protecting and improving our natural resources and the environment while also significantly controlling greenhouse gases, was unanimously passed and signed by Gov. Spencer Cox. The resolution focuses primarily on improving federal forest management to better prevent catastrophic wildfires. The emphasis centers on natural sequestration and land management rather than restricting fossil fuel use directly, allowing 'transition to the energy sources of the future more gradually' while 'still providing the affordable, abundant and reliable energy.'

HCR1 — Concurrent Resolution to Work Together to Address the Climate, Public Lands and Carbon Sequestration. Floor Sponsor: Sen. David P. Hinkins. Bill Sponsor: Rep. Keven J. Stratton. Aims to encourage best management practices to reduce carbon emissions while preserving and expanding forest and other lands to improve climate outcomes.
